caveats: Offset Monte Carlo (input-offset-mc) was run at a FIXED 1.20 V supply only: five <corner>_mismatch sections x {-40, 27, 125} degC. The supply axis (1.08 V / 1.32 V) is covered only by the deterministic systematic-offset record; no statistical figure here is a statement about 1.08 V or 1.32 V.

Systematic and statistical offset are distinct evidence: the ratified bound is the systematic (nominal-device) half [DR-2]; the mismatch-driven 3σ half is measured [P] and is not ratified (DR-0002 residual (b), pending its own two-key pass). This report does not combine them into a ratified total.

The CMRR row is ratified on its mismatch-inclusive figure [DR-4], whose definition (Av0 minus the +3σ point of the drawn-Acm distribution, mean + 3σ in the LINEAR domain, N = 300 + process corners) is part of the number. This report reads that per-point figure from the record and re-derives it from the record's own linear mean and σ (definition check cmrr_linear_3sigma); it never aggregates in the dB domain. The superseded systematic floor is shown as context only.
Output swing is unloaded (CL = 2 pF, no resistive load): an upper bound. PSRR+ is ratified at the DC shelf and is strongly frequency-dependent.
Every measured row comes from nominal-device deterministic benches except the two Monte Carlo records (offset, CMRR); no other row carries a statistical basis.

Bound precision is an open spec question, not settled by this report: three DR-0002 bounds (integrated noise <= 108.9 µVrms, systematic offset <= 21.9 mV, swing span >= 0.571 V) are stricter than the raw worst case of the very records DR-0002 cites, which only round onto them (108.949 µVrms, 21.927 mV, 0.570958 V). This report compares literally, so those rows FAIL. Whether to restate the bounds or ratify a comparison convention is for the keys in a decision record: 2AMLogic/sg13g2-opamp#101.

The four open-loop rows (DC gain, GBW, phase margin, Iq) read the corrected inn-AC-grounded record open-loop-ac (issue #241), which supersedes the inn-floating record open-loop-ac-floating-inn; the earlier DC-gain literal FAIL (37.7812 dB) was a reading of the superseded record and is preserved in the earlier reports, unedited. The corrected record's Iq column iq_a is the OP envelope's total VDD current, including the 10 µA ibias reference, and its Av0, GBW and PM are read from the AC envelope (PM = 180 + degrees(phase at the 0 dB crossing)).

The corrected open-loop record is validated from its pinned klt-sim envelopes (definition check open_loop_klt_audit), not from the legacy op_pass / gm_status columns it does not carry. The legacy internal-node saturation proxy (vd1, vd2, vtail) and the gain-margin status are NOT re-measured by the corrected bench: the report relies on the DC operating point being unchanged by the AC ground element and joins the superseded record's op_pass as stated, disclosed evidence for that, confirmed by Vout and total VDD current agreeing with it to 10 µV and 10 nA. Fresh internal-node evidence would need a separately authorized run.

The CMRR mismatch record joined its Av0 from the superseded inn-floating open-loop record, and its summary still states those Av0 values; this report keeps that join on open-loop-ac-floating-inn (selected, hash-pinned) rather than silently re-stamping the CMRR result as recomputed against the corrected Av0. The CMRR and PSRR figures are therefore not claimed to reflect the corrected open-loop record; that needs separately authorized new evidence.

The corrected open-loop envelopes ran on the batch fleet, whose worker could not read the PDK release stamp (pdk_stamp_comparison not_comparable): the model deck is identified by its sha256 and the engine by its version, but run-time PDK release identity is not verified for this record (PDK provenance stays legacy/unverified).
content.comparison_rule: Each ratified bound is compared literally: every valid grid point's raw measured value, scaled to the bound's unit, must satisfy the bound exactly as written in spec/target-spec.md (e.g. >= 37.8 means 37.7999 fails). No rounding, tolerance or precision convention is applied: no ratification record defines one, and choosing one is a spec decision, not the report's. The worst value rounded to the bound's written decimals is shown for information only and never gates a verdict. A point that fails its record's validity flags never contributes an extremum: it is counted as missing coverage, so a failed simulation point can only make a row INCOMPLETE, never PASS.
content.draws_audit_rule: Offset Monte Carlo statistics audit (issue #199): a record that selects a raw draws population (`draws_csv`, pinned by sha256 beside its summary) has every published per-point statistic recomputed from that population exactly as sim/input-offset/run_offset_mc.sh computes it -- accumulation in draw order, mean = sum/n_pass, sample sigma with the N-1 denominator, three-sigma = 3 sigma, min/max over the passing draws, and worst-case total = |vos_systematic_det_v| + three-sigma. A committed summary cell passes only when it is that recomputed value as the bench serializes it (printf %.9g, nine significant digits), i.e. within half a unit in the 9th significant digit (5e-9 relative); a cell that differs beyond its own serialization is an error naming the point and the offending field. The draws population itself must be complete and singular: missing, duplicated, mismatched or non-finite PASS draws fail the record rather than quietly shrinking it. The negative-control (negctrl) draws are a separate population: audited on their own draws like every other point's, never pooled into the mismatch statistics.

pdk_provenance.note: The configured release shown above (sim/pdk.json) is the CONFIGURED release, not run-time evidence. content.klt_audit_rule: Open-loop `klt sim` raw-evidence audit (issue #101): a record that selects `klt_raw` (the AC and OP `klt sim` envelopes, the `klt pex --measure-command` measurement document, both requests and the bench circuit body, each sha256-pinned) is audited offline against them in place of the legacy `op_pass` / `gm_status` validity columns it does not carry. Both envelopes must be status pass with 45 unique, diagnostic-free passing corners and agree on engine, model deck, PDK and the simulated circuit: the DUT snapshot hash recorded in the envelope must be the selected snapshot's, and the bench body must be the pinned one with exactly one CL, `Lbreak inn out 1e18`, `Cinn_acgnd inn vss 1` (inn AC-grounded), the 10 uA `Iibias` reference and a 1 V AC source on inp; CL must be a load the record's own prose states. Per point the four graded cells are recomputed from the raw envelopes -- Av0 and GBW verbatim from the AC envelope, PM as 180 + degrees(phase at the 0 dB crossing), Iq as the OP envelope's total VDD current (-i(vdd), which INCLUDES the 10 uA ibias reference) -- and must equal the committed cell as the converter serializes it (printf %.6g), and must also equal the measurement document. The operating-point sanity the legacy `op_pass` applied is recomputed from the raw OP values where they exist: Vcm = VDD/2 (within the bench's 1e-4 fraction), |Vout - VDD/2| <= 0.15 VDD, 0.02 VDD <= Vout <= 0.98 VDD. The legacy check on the internal nodes (vd1, vd2, vtail) and the gain-margin `gm_status` are NOT re-measured by the corrected bench: the DC operating point does not depend on the AC ground element, so the selected `dc_continuity` record is joined as the stated evidence for them -- its point must have op_pass=1 and its Vout and total VDD current must agree with the corrected OP envelope within 10 uV and 10 nA; that dependence is disclosed, never presented as a fresh internal-node measurement. A missing, changed, stale-pinned or inconsistent artifact is an error naming the point and file.
content.noise_audit_rule: Input-noise raw-evidence audit (issue #213): a record that selects raw noise artifacts (`noise_raw`, one sha256-pinned ngspice log and one sha256-pinned in-band spectrum per grid point) is audited offline against them, with the post-processing in sim/input-noise/noise_post.py -- the module run_noise_sweep.sh itself runs. Two independent checks per point: (1) integrated-log: `vni_int_vrms` must be the single NOISE_INOISE_TOTAL token of the pinned log, which the bench copies verbatim (so equality is exact, not toleranced); (2) spectrum-derived: the five spot densities, the flicker (A/f) and thermal (B) weighted-least-squares split, the flicker corner and flicker fraction, and the trapezoidal cross-check ratio against the logged total are recomputed from the pinned spectrum and each cell must equal the recomputed value as the bench serializes it (printf %.6g, six significant digits; `nan` where undefined). The trapezoidal spectrum integral is the bench's cross-check of the logged figure, never a substitute for it: neither check can mask the other. The spectrum must be the documented band (100 Hz - 1 MHz, 81 points, dec 20, strictly increasing) with finite positive samples; a missing, duplicated, malformed, non-finite or stale-pinned artifact is an error naming the point and file. A summary edited with its own hash refreshed still fails while the pinned raw artifacts disagree.
not_claimed: Not item 5 or item 6 evidence: it is a generic, offline aggregation of harness-native records, not a `klt sim` or `klt yield` envelope, and the signoff manifest cites it for item 8 only.
Not a re-run: regenerating this report re-reads committed records; it does not re-simulate anything. Re-running the benches is the separate cold-start procedure in each sim/ bench README.
Not a claim that every T1 item is satisfied; post-layout (PEX) re-simulation does not exist yet, so every number here is pre-layout.

overall.rule: ERROR if any input is in error; else FAIL if any ratified (binding) row fails its bound; else INCOMPLETE if any non-pending row lacks full valid grid coverage; else PASS. Superseded rows are context and never FAIL the report; measured rows carry no bound; Area is PENDING.

content.samples_audit_rule: CMRR mismatch statistics audit (issue #208): a record that selects raw sample files (`mc_samples`, one sha256-pinned `<point>_mc_samples.txt` per grid point) has every published per-point statistic recomputed offline from those samples by the SAME function the bench uses (sim/cmrr-mismatch/mc_samples.py point_stats): the strict parser (exactly one finite OP and one AC record per draw), the op_fail / plateau_fail acceptance rules with the pinned thresholds, the accepted/excluded counts, the LINEAR-domain Acm mean and N-1 sample sigma, and the DR-0004 bound Av0 - 20log10(mean + 3 sigma). Each committed cell must equal the recomputed value as the bench serializes it (printf %.6g, six significant digits). Av0 is joined from the explicitly selected, hash-pinned deterministic record (`av0_join`), never taken from the summary. A summary edited coherently (mean, sigma and CMRR together) while the pinned samples stay unchanged is an error naming the point and field, as is any unparseable, truncated, duplicated or stale-pinned population.
content.slew_audit_rule: Slew-rate raw-evidence audit (issue #227): a record that selects raw transient evidence (`slew_raw`, one sha256-pinned `wrdata` v(out) waveform and one sha256-pinned rendered bench netlist per grid point, plus the measurement configuration) is audited offline against it, with the measurement in sim/slew-rate/slew_post.py -- the module run_slew_sweep.sh itself runs. The configuration (edge intervals, outer and inner windows) must be exactly the bench's, and the supply, common-mode voltage, step schedule and stop time of each pinned rendered netlist must agree with it. Per point the four edge rates (first interpolated crossing of the window edges inside the edge interval), the worse edge, the waveform extrema, the window limits and the waveform-derived linearity and traverse flags are recomputed, and each committed cell must equal the recomputed value as the bench serializes it (printf %.6g, six significant digits; flags 0/1), with no tolerance beyond that serialization. A waveform that is missing, changed, assigned to another point, non-finite, out of time order or without the needed crossings cannot yield a passing measurement. A summary edited coherently (rise, fall and worst together, hash refreshed) still fails while the pinned waveforms disagree.

content.swing_audit_rule: Output-swing raw-evidence audit (issue #230): a record that selects raw DC evidence (`swing_raw`, one sha256-pinned coarse and one fine transfer-curve wrdata file and one sha256-pinned rendered bench netlist per pass and grid point, plus the measurement configuration) is audited offline against it, with the measurement in sim/output-swing/swing_post.py -- the module run_swing_sweep.sh itself runs. The configuration (coarse window, fine half-span and step, the 0.5 x peak criterion) must be exactly the bench's, and each pinned rendered netlist must agree with it: supply, common mode (VDD/2), corner section, temperature, sweep window, recorded vectors, wrdata target and pass label -- the fine window centred on the coarse crossing recomputed from the pinned coarse curve, and each curve exactly as many samples as its netlist's sweep declares. Per point the unique-crossing and plateau checks, the tracking bounds at the sampled 0.5-times-peak region, both headrooms, the span, the fine interpolated crossing, the peak incremental gain and the mid-swing supply current are recomputed, and each committed cell must equal the recomputed value as the bench serializes it (printf %.9g, nine significant digits; op_pass 0/1), with no tolerance beyond that serialization. Curves are strictly parsed: missing, truncated, malformed or non-finite samples, repeated or reversed sweep scales and mismatched wrdata scale columns are errors naming the point and file, as are multiple or missing coarse crossings and a fine window that truncates the accepted region. A summary edited coherently (bounds, headrooms and span together, hash refreshed) still fails while the pinned curves disagree. The record's cross-bench diagnostic columns (vos_offset_record_v, vos_delta_v, av0_ac_record_db, av0_ratio, ivdd_ac_record_a, ivdd_ratio) are logged, not gated (the bench README's "Cross-checks") and stay outside this audit.
